Share your data with Budget <App> & Co

Budget Holdings Pty Ltd asks Coastal Bank to share your data. Budget Holdings Pty Ltd uses the brand name Budget <App> & Co and the application Budget Tracker.

Data that Coastal Bank will share

Account name, type and balance

  • Name of account
  • Type of account
  • Account balance

How long Coastal Bank will share your data

Coastal Bank will share your data one time.

The data includes data from before today that Coastal Bank has for the accounts that you select.

You can stop the sharing at any time. Sign in to Coastal Bank online banking and go to Data sharing, or ask Coastal Bank.

Select the accounts to share

Coastal Bank is not a real bank and this is just a demonstration. CDR Lab has no affiliation with any real bank nor the ACCC, DSB, or any real CDR participant.
